A sketch of the phase space with nullclines and the corresponding direction field of tangents to the solutions of a system of differential equations is shown above (the tangents are not drawn to scale). Which of the following could represent the trajectory starting at the point marked on the graph?
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point and go along with the flow (slightly downward and to the right) until the trajectory intersects the $y$-nullcline, where the tangents are horizontal.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/659a566b441d61748a82d4c8b67632432656fad3f8af65cd3a6446062c957817.png)

- Next, the flow continues going to the right but then turns upward.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/2e844f0034ee039a7a97c836099caa983eca9c861d66337772203db991d0f07d.png)

- After that, the trajectory keeps going  to the right and slightly upward to infinity.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/b21e1215502adee98e275e59d1a391665f3cc8b75a69b8c5497739d2b919cc9f.png)
